text:
Type: six-drawer rolling drawer unit
Use: storing papers, art supplies and stationery under or beside a desk; home office, study, craft room
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: painted board with a smooth matte finish, black plastic casters
Colors: dark charcoal grey, black
Shape: wide low box with six shallow full-width drawers, curved cut-out finger grips at the top of each front, flat top, four casters, compact and solid, medium visual weight
Feel: neat, functional, calm, studious
Goes with: white or grey desks, black accents, light wood; modern home offices and minimalist workspaces

product.name: ALEX
product.description: Drawer stops prevent the drawer from being pulled out too far.
